_note: Four outfits (Backlog F22, plan sheet Pillars). load = the starting hold (must fit the knarr), gear = fixed kit, ease = mini-game difficulty steps (-1 easier, +1 harder), roles = named crew roles carried, lead = the named leaders. Economy multipliers live on the plan's Assumptions sheet under OUTFITS AND CREW ROLES.

merchant.name: Merchant
merchant.strength: Red cloth and iron; better prices at the market
merchant.weakness: Poor foragers; the animals eat the margin

farm_household.name: Farm household
farm_household.strength: Livestock, cheese, a hand with fodder; the byre goes up faster
farm_household.weakness: Little cargo to trade, few fighters
farm_household.feel: The byre is easier, the hold is tighter.

hunter_boat.name: Hunter-boat
hunter_boat.strength: Fishing and pilotage: a better hand on the star ring, more hooks, a second net
hunter_boat.weakness: Weak builders, weak at the market

shipwright_s_kin.name: Shipwright's kin
shipwright_s_kin.strength: Hull repair, a spare sail, better timber
